paragraphs.paragraph-1: Front-end Developer with over 14 years of experience building modern web applications and scalable front-end architectures, with a strong focus on React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
paragraphs.paragraph-2: I have deeply integrated AI-assisted development into my engineering workflow, leveraging LLMs, AI coding agents, and AI-powered development tools across different stages of the software development lifecycle — from technical research, architecture, and implementation to debugging, refactoring, testing, code review, and documentation. I use AI to enhance productivity and accelerate problem-solving while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and solution architecture.
paragraphs.paragraph-3: In addition to software development, I have over 10 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong background in SEO, web performance, content management, and digital platforms, including WordPress and Strapi. I have experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and contributing to technical documentation, project organization, and development processes.
paragraphs.paragraph-4: Throughout my career I also took on tasks in related areas, where I acquired knowledge in:

design.title: Design
design.summary: Layout creation, image manipulation, use of tools like Figma, Photoshop and Illustrator. Knowledge of UX/UI.

seo.title: SEO
seo.summary: Technical SEO, code optimization, headers and directives configuration, sitemap creation and use of tools like Semrush, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

devops.title: DevOps
devops.summary: CI/CD, Git and Git Flow, standardization of settings, definition of environments, sense of urgency, adaptability and teamwork.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.summary: Configuration of Linux servers (Debian/Ubuntu), configuration of web servers such as Apache and Nginx, creation of virtual machines and databases on Google Cloud, installation of various components, SSH connection configuration, firewall adjustment and opening of ports and configuration of SSL certificates.
